requirement.part: cantilever bracket, load at the tip

brief:
Part: cantilever bracket, load at the tip. Solid rectangular cross-section, width across the load, thickness in the load direction.
Load 600 N at the tip, length 150 mm.
REQ-001 yield margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.25 (MS = allowable / (factor x stress) - 1).
REQ-002 ultimate margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.4.
REQ-003 tip deflection <= 1.5 mm.
REQ-004 width 20-80 mm, thickness 3-8 mm.
REQ-005 thickness must be a stock plate thickness: [3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30] mm.
REQ-006 REQ-001 to REQ-003 must still hold with the load 10% higher and the plate 0.5 mm thinner.
REQ-007 thickness / width <= 2 (a proxy for lateral stability).
Materials: {"Al 6061-T6": {"density_kg_m3": 2700, "youngs_modulus_gpa": 68.9, "yield_mpa": 276.0, "ultimate_mpa": 310.0}, "Ti-6Al-4V": {"density_kg_m3": 4430, "youngs_modulus_gpa": 113.8, "yield_mpa": 880.0, "ultimate_mpa": 950.0}, "Steel 4130": {"density_kg_m3": 7850, "youngs_modulus_gpa": 205.0, "yield_mpa": 435.0, "ultimate_mpa": 670.0}}
Goal: the lowest mass that meets every requirement.

reasoning: Cantilever with P=600 N, L=150 mm gives M=90 N·m. Stress is 540000/(b·h²) MPa and tip deflection is 8.1e9/(E·b·h³) mm, with E in MPa. Allowables with factors: Al yield 276/1.25=220.8 MPa and ultimate 310/1.4=221.4 MPa; Ti ultimate 950/1.4=678.6 MPa; Steel yield 435/1.25=348 MPa. REQ-006 (P=660 N, h-0.5 mm) makes deflection the binding check. With b≤80 and h≤8 (REQ-004), Al (b·h³≥86,211 mm⁴ needed, max 40,960) and Ti (needs b≥124 mm at h=7.5) cannot meet stiffness. Steel 4130 at h=8 mm needs b≈69 mm for deflection, with stress and REQ-007 satisfied, so b≈70 mm, h=8 mm is the lightest feasible candidate (about 0.66 kg for a 150 mm length).

notes.Al 6061-T6: Stiffness is the binding limit: at h=8 mm and b=80 mm, b·h³=40,960 mm⁴ gives about 2.9 mm tip deflection against the 1.5 mm limit, and REQ-006 is worse. Search only to confirm infeasibility across b 20-80 and h 3-8, since no stock thickness up to 8 mm meets REQ-003.
notes.Ti-6Al-4V: Its E of 113.8 GPa is too low for the 1.5 mm limit: with h=7.5 mm (REQ-006 case) it would need b≈124 mm, above the 80 mm maximum, even though its 678.6 MPa ultimate allowable is ample. Search b 20-80 and h 3-8 only to confirm infeasibility, not for a lightweight solution.
notes.Steel 4130: Search h=8 mm (the only stock thickness that works) with b≈69-80 mm, where the REQ-006 deflection needs b≥68.7 mm and the 348 MPa yield allowable needs b≥30 mm. Check b=70 mm first, then confirm REQ-007 (h/b=0.11 ≤2) and the ultimate check, which governs only at 478.6 MPa.

summary: The compliance engine reports all six structural rules (S-01 to S-06) and the material and fabrication checks M-02, M-03, F-01 and F-02 as pass, but M-01, M-04, M-05, X-01, X-02 and P-01 to P-03 remain action items, so the bracket is not compliance-complete. The open items centre on handbook-only allowables (M-01), unanalyzed fatigue (X-02), and unresolved specialty-metal, traceability and supplier-quality requirements (P-01 to P-03).
top_risks: Fatigue is not analyzed (X-02), so launch vibration and other cyclic loads are unassessed despite passing static margins S-01 to S-03.
Design allowables are typical handbook values (M-01), so the passing margins S-01 to S-03 may not hold once MMPDS A- or B-basis values are applied.
Specialty metal melt origin (P-01) and the AS9100 supplier requirement (P-03) may disqualify the planned AMS 6350 source, which would also affect traceability (P-02).

actions.action: Replace typical values with MMPDS A- or B-basis allowables for 4130, the applicable temper and the 8 mm thickness, then rerun S-01 to S-03.
Define cyclic load cases, including launch vibration, and run a fatigue analysis before release.
Classify the bracket (for example non-fracture-critical) per the program fracture control standard and record the rationale.
Confirm the specialty metal melt origin meets DFARS 252.225-7009 with each candidate vendor before award.
Specify the corrosion protection finish (plating or primer and paint) under the program finish spec.

memo: Recommendation: award the order for 10 Steel 4130 brackets to Vendor B (sample), which was selected by the weighted scoring (price 0.6, lead time 0.4) after bidding at $104.48 each with a 13-day lead time and passing eligibility checks with no flags. Vendor A (sample) was also eligible and bid $134.07 each with an 18-day lead time, but its higher price and longer lead time led the scoring to rank it below Vendor B. Vendor C (sample) and Vendor D (sample) were not chosen because they did not bid and were ineligible, with Vendor C lacking an AS9100 quality system and Vendor D unable to certify a DFARS compliant melt source.
